sections.heading: How It Works
paragraphs: Dr. Salt replaces a portion of sodium chloride with a mineral salt blend that tastes close to regular salt, so you use it exactly the way you'd use any table salt.
The result is a salt that measurably lowers your sodium intake per pinch, without changing how you cook or season your food.

pageTitle: DFS Salt | Double Fortified Salt with Iron & Iodine
metaDescription: DFS Salt is Ankur's Double Fortified Salt, fortified with both iron and iodine to help address anaemia and iodine deficiency in one everyday ingredient.

image.alt: DFS Salt, Double Fortified Salt with Iron and Iodine

heroImage.alt: DFS Salt pack, double fortified with iron and iodine

comparison.bestFor: Everyday goodness for the whole family

grid.description: Double fortified salt with iron and iodine, one everyday step toward fighting anaemia.

detail.heroTagline: Everyday Goodness for the Whole Family. Double Fortified with Iron & Iodine. Supports Normal Haemoglobin Formation and anaemia friendly diets.

sections.heading: Why Fortified Salt
paragraphs: Salt is one of the few ingredients almost every household already uses every day, which makes it an effective, low cost carrier for essential micronutrients.
DFS Salt is double fortified: alongside iodine for thyroid health, it carries iron to help address one of India's most widespread nutrition gaps.

stats.label: Essential nutrients fortified in every pinch: iron and iodine

sections.heading: Anaemia Awareness
paragraphs: Iron deficiency anaemia remains widespread across India, often silently, showing up as fatigue, reduced immunity, and impaired growth in children.
Double Fortified Salt (DFS) is recommended by public health researchers as a scalable way to improve everyday iron intake through an ingredient already present in every kitchen.
